title: [EPIC] Misskey API compatibility
description: Add Misskey-specific features and API compatibility to all three servers. Misskey family (Misskey, Firefish, Sharkey, Calckey) has ~1M users, mostly in Japan. Key differentiators: emoji reactions (not just favourites), drive (file management), antennas (custom feeds), clips (categorized bookmarks). Federates with Misskey instances already (they speak AP) but Misskey-specific clients need the Misskey API.
